visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with close-up shots of hands on a yellow cutting board, precisely slicing fresh shiitake mushrooms into thick slices, followed by cutting a roll of bean curd skin into uniform segments. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the ingredients. (2) The focus shifts to a green loofah being peeled and then sliced into bite-sized quarters. Next, enoki mushrooms are removed from their packaging, rinsed, and chopped into three sections. (3) Hands crack two eggs into a white bowl and whisk them with a pair of chopsticks. In a separate small dish, goji berries are soaked in a small amount of dark liquid. (4) A brown frying pan is heated on an induction stove; oil is added, and the bean curd rolls are fried until they develop a golden-brown crust. Shiitake mushrooms are then added to the pan to be sautéed alongside. (5) The loofah slices are added to the pan with seasoning, followed by hot water. The previously fried bean curd and enoki mushrooms are reintroduced to the pot, which is then covered with a lid to simmer. (6) In a separate pan, the egg wash is fried into large, browned pieces and then added to the main noodle soup. Dried thin noodles are placed into the simmering broth. (7) The final stage shows the soup bubbling with all ingredients integrated; goji berries are added last. The camera transitions to a medium shot of a woman with short dark hair wearing a grey apron, happily holding a large bowl of the finished noodles and eating them with chopsticks in a kitchen setting.
